title: VALUEFLOW: Toward Pluralistic and Steerable Value-based Alignment in Large Language Models
findings: The paper found that its profile-based steering method significantly improved the accuracy of predicting responses for the 'Religion' demographic group on the OpinionQA benchmark, for instance, increasing accuracy for the Phi-4 model from 44.5% to 58.9%. Additionally, the study demonstrated that its framework could be successfully extended to non-Western value systems, showing that models could be consistently steered towards Buddhist ethical principles like mindfulness and non-attachment.
